title: Find a product allowance 1
scenario: An invented allowance register has one unique product key per row. All allowance values are numeric CAD amounts; zero is a permitted allowance. All records and limits are fictitious training assumptions.

lesson.intro: An exact lookup matches a key, not a row position. Explicitly define what happens when the key is absent. A numeric zero returned from an existing record remains zero.

formulas.name: XLOOKUP
formulas.explanation: lookup_value is the key; aligned lookup_array and return_array contain keys and results. Optional if_not_found handles absence, match_mode 0 means exact, and search_mode controls search direction.

task.prompt: Look up the Allowance_CAD for exact Product_code LK1-014. An absent key must return the text Missing. Keys are unique, so there is no duplicate selection. Preserve a matched numeric zero; do not round a numeric allowance. Return one numeric value in Answers!B2. Use an Excel formula; any equivalent approach is accepted. Submit the formula and the complete output.

columns.name: Product_code
columns.description: Unique exact text key, including leading-zero numeric segments.

columns.name: Allowance_CAD
columns.description: Numeric allowance in CAD, including a legitimate zero. No blanks.
